content:
Looking for great iPhone and iPad games to play? The App Store has plenty of ad-free, in-app purchase-free games to choose from.

Apple Arcade is a family-friendly subscription, but it's not the only option. If you already subscribe to Netflix, you can also access a huge library of great iPhone and iPad games.

Your Netflix subscription includes a massive library of iPhone and iPad games

Every Netflix subscription plan now includes access to a large library of mobile and smart TV games.

This includes the most affordable tier, 'Standard with Ads', at $8.99 per month.

No matter which Netflix plan you choose, you'll get ad-free, in-app purchase-free access to mobile and smart TV games at no extra cost.

For smart TV gaming, Netflix offers an iPhone and iPad app called Netflix Game Controller.

This app turns your phone or tablet into a game controller for use with supported versions of the Netflix smart TV app. If you want to take your mobile gaming to the next level, a dedicated iPhone controller is the way to go.

Netflix also has an iPhone and iPad app called Netflix Playground, designed for kids with a variety of mini-games. There's also Netflix Puzzled: Logic Games (no subscription required) and Netflix Stories.

Beyond these titles, Netflix supports over 80 iPhone and iPad games. You can download any of them from the App Store and sign in with your Netflix email and password to start playing.
